---
title: "Login with Two-Factor Authentication"
---

After the two-factor authentication activation, user can now login with 2 different authentication factors.

For login to SnagR on website, the two authentication factors are:  
**1. User credential**  
**2. Verification code generated on Google Authenticator app**.

For login to SnagR on device, the two authentication factors are:  
**1. User credential**  
**2. Device passcode/fingerprint**

<img src="/images/uploads/123693-if_ic_tv_48px_352186.png" alt="if ic tv 48px 352186" width="20" /> **Website**

Enter **Username and password**

<img src="/images/direct/1547006777634-Admin_Website-login-.001.jpeg" alt="Admin Website (login).001" />

Open Google Authenticator app or any TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password) supporting app to get the verification code.

**Enter 6-digit code**

<img src="/images/direct/1547006798752-Admin_Website-login-.002.jpeg" alt="Admin Website (login).002" />

You now successfully login to the project!

<img src="/images/direct/1547006912577-Admin_Website-login-.003.jpeg" alt="Admin Website (login).003" />

<img src="/images/uploads/123669-if_icons_mobile_1564515.png" alt="if icons mobile 1564515" width="18" /> **Device**

Enter **Username and password**

<img src="/images/direct/1547007157426-Admin_Device-login-.001.jpeg" alt="Admin Device (login).001" />

Enter your **device passcode**

<img src="/images/uploads/127041-Red_Flag_Emoji.png" alt="Red Flag Emoji" width="18" /> For iOS device, you **must** enter device passcode/fingerprint to login to the project after entering your account password on the login page.

<img src="/images/uploads/127041-Red_Flag_Emoji.png" alt="Red Flag Emoji" width="20" /> For Android device, the SnagR App will allow you to login to the project **only when a device passcode/fingerprint is set up**. Otherwise, SnagR app will not let you login to the project until a device passcode/fingerprint is set up.

<img src="/images/direct/1547007186445-Admin_Device-login-.002.jpeg" alt="Admin Device (login).002" />

You now successfully login to the project!

<img src="/images/direct/1547007825549-Admin_Device-login-.003.jpeg" alt="Admin Device (login).003" />

### Hints and Tips

### Do I need to generate the verification code on TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password) supporting app or Google Authenticator everytime I login?

You do not need to do that. The verification linkage will stay on the authenticator app after your Two-Factor Authentication activation. You just need to go back to the app and get the verification code everytime you login.

Click [here](/en/faq/general/2fa) to see how to activate Two-Factor Authentication.

### Do I need to remember the 6-digit verification code?

No, the 6-digit verification code **regenerate automatically every 30 seconds** on the authenticator app you are using.

### How can I reset the verification key/How can I get the QR Code?

Click [here](/en/set-up-project/accounts-and-permissions-project-level/reset2fa) to know more.
